description: This file declares the PDUParser class used for handling and parsing Protocol Data Units (PDUs) in a modem simulator context. It includes methods for creating, validating, and extracting information from PDUs, as well as static utility functions for encoding conversions.

classes.name: PDUParser
classes.description: A class for parsing, creating, and validating SMS Protocol Data Units (PDUs) in a modem simulation environment.

methods.name: IsValidPDU
methods.description: Checks if the current PDU is valid.

methods.name: IsNeededStatuReport
methods.description: Determines if a status report is needed for the current PDU.

methods.name: CreatePDU
methods.description: Creates a new PDU string based on internal data.

methods.name: CreateRemotePDU
methods.description: Creates a remote PDU with specified host and port information.

methods.name: CreateStatuReport
methods.description: Generates a status report PDU based on a message reference.

methods.name: GetPhoneNumberFromAddress
methods.description: Extracts the phone number from the originator address field.

methods.name: BCDToString
methods.description: Converts a BCD-encoded string to a human-readable string.

methods.name: StringToBCD
methods.description: Converts a string to its BCD-encoded representation.

methods.name: DecodePDU
methods.description: Decodes a PDU string into internal fields.

methods.name: Hex2ToByte
methods.description: Converts a two-character hex string to a byte.

methods.name: HexCharToInt
methods.description: Converts a single hex character to its integer value.

methods.name: IntToHexString
methods.description: Converts an integer to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: IntToHexStringTimeZoneDiff
methods.description: Converts a timezone difference value to its hex string representation.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a string.
